segments.title: Chương 11: 《Sắp thi đại học, hệ thống ly hôn nghịch tập đến》11. Đôi bàn chân trắng như tuyết
segments.content:
Chapter 11: The Snow-White Foot. "Come on! Bottoms up!"

The air outside the barbecue restaurant was smoky and scorching, with a large industrial fan blowing greasy smoke toward the sky.

On the artificial turf, a dozen large wooden round tables were set up, surrounded by pink plastic chairs. Under the bright floodlights, eight or nine students clinked their beer glasses together.

"Why isn't Jiang Nian here?" someone asked.

"Probably has no money, who knows." A boy said nonchalantly as the small hot pot on the table bubbled away. "He hasn't spoken to us at all these past few days."

Le Zhi, sitting in his seat, looked a little awkward. He and Jiang Nian were on good terms and he knew the reason. Seeing the conversation going off track, he couldn't help but explain.

"Hey, it's about what happened last time. He must have overheard when we were all joking around. Jiang Nian's probably just sulking. It'll be fine once we talk it out."

"What's there to talk about? It's his choice whether he comes or not," Zhou Yuting said suddenly.

"Huh?" Le Zhi didn't expect Zhou Yuting to speak up and was momentarily flustered.

This group of people had always gathered around Zhou Yuting. Now that she had spoken, the others naturally became more aggressive in their criticism of Jiang Nian.

"A poor schmuck is a poor schmuck. What's wrong with saying a few words about him?"

"Exactly. Why act so sensitive? What's the point of someone who can't even take a joke? If he doesn't want to come, he doesn't have to. Does he expect our Study Committee Member to go and coax him?"

Zhou Yuting was the Study Committee Member, and her grades were always in the top five of the class. Her family was wealthy, she was smart, had a great figure, knew how to have fun, and was always very popular with the opposite sex.

It was true that Le Zhi had a crush on Zhou Yuting, but he listened as the people at the table relentlessly put down Jiang Nian. At first, he thought it would be just a few remarks, but then he realized they were even starting to bring his mother into it.

They didn't stop cursing, instead getting more and more worked up, their words becoming more and more outrageous.

"Ha, there's no need for this, is there?"

"What do you mean 'no need'? Have we said anything wrong? A poor schmuck is a poor schmuck. Poor ghosts give birth to poor ghosts. They'll never amount to anything in their whole lives."

Even though Le Zhi's relationship with Jiang Nian was just so-so, and he really didn't want to contradict Zhou Yuting, he couldn't control his temper upon hearing this.

With a loud bang, Le Zhi shot to his feet, furious.

"That's enough!"

"Are you fucking sick in the head? Jiang Nian not coming doesn't mean you have to bring his family into it. Anyone who didn't know better would think the motherfucker killed your moms."

"I fucking can't stand you bunch of idiots. It's better to be friends with a dog than with you lot. Go drink your fucking alcohol!"

Le Zhi spat out the string of curses in one breath, slapped three one-hundred yuan bills on the table, and left without a second glance at the group.

At the table, there was dead silence.

After a few seconds, someone snapped out of it.

He stood up, grabbing a beer bottle with a smack, and stared at Le Zhi's retreating back, his eyes red as he roared.

"You idiot! Don't you fucking dare leave if you have any guts!"

"What are you doing!" Zhou Yuting said, displeased. She shot the person a glare. "He's already gone. What's the use of saying that now!"

"But..."

"Sit down!" Zhou Yuting crossed her arms and gave him a sharp look. "Do you know who Le Zhi's father is? If you lay a hand on him, you won't be out for fifteen days. You don't want to study anymore?"

Liu Feipeng was leisurely sipping his beer, listening to the conversation with a silent smile. The upturned corners of his mouth mocked not only Jiang Nian but also the other boys at the table.

A bunch of poor, stupid dogs. Did they really think they could win the goddess's favor by ostracizing Jiang Nian?

He saw things very clearly. Le Zhi's father was a leader in the county's Public Security Bureau. Although Le Zhi usually acted effeminate, it seemed he had some backbone on occasion.

This made Liu Feipeng think a little more highly of Le Zhi. At least he wasn't one of those brain-dead simps. He was qualified to compete with him.

Besides, he also understood that Zhou Yuting was very clever; she wouldn't distance herself from Le Zhi over this matter. What she valued was background. In a small county, background and power were the most important things.

The cake of victory should be enjoyed by someone stable and powerful like himself. "Ahem." A smile appeared on Liu Feipeng's face as he spoke, breaking the gloomy atmosphere. "Yuting, how did you do on this exam? Any chance of moving up to the advanced class?"

With that one sentence, the atmosphere at the table returned to normal.

Zhou Yuting frowned. "I did alright, but I'm not sure if there's a chance."

"It's fine." Liu Feipeng smiled, looking like a dependable big brother. "I asked around. This exam was generally quite difficult. You might be able to move up with a 530."

"Really?" Zhou Yuting's eyes lit up. "My estimated score is 510. If I'm lucky, I might have a chance to touch the 530 mark."

"Mm, it doesn't matter even if you're a little short." Liu Feipeng smiled, mentioning as if by chance, "My father is quite familiar with our grade's director."

"He was the one who said it today. If it really doesn't work out, I can put in a good word for you."

"Okay, then thank you in advance, Peng-ge," Zhou Yuting said with a well-behaved expression.

The educational resources in the Olympiad class were a world apart from those in the parallel classes. It wasn't that the teachers were biased, but that the academic foundations of the two levels of classes were different.

Zhou Yuting had always ranked in the top five of her class. Just last week, her homeroom teacher had spoken to her, telling her to study hard and try to move up to the Olympiad class.

If she could move up and establish herself in the Olympiad class, a Tier 1 university would be a sure thing, and a top-tier one would be within reach. She had always wanted to attend Lu University, a school in a coastal city.

Under the lights, Jiang Nian opened the white box and took out the ointment for bruises and sprains with a solemn expression.

After opening the lid, a strong medicinal smell hit him.

He turned around and shook his head.

"How on earth did you manage to sprain your ankle? Xu Qianqian, were you lost in romantic daydreams while walking up the stairs?"

In the Xu family living room, Xu Qianqian, sitting on the sofa, gritted her teeth at his words!

"You're the one daydreaming! It was because... because there was a mouse!"

"Mice are so cute, how can you be afraid of them?" Jiang Nian sighed and walked over to her, looking down at her. "Tsk, tsk."

His "tsk, tsk" infuriated Xu Qianqian, and she threw a cushion at him.

"Get lost! I'll apply it myself!"

"That won't do. Old Xu isn't off work yet, so I have to help you apply the medicine." A savage smile appeared on Jiang Nian's face. "Besides, how could I pass up such a good opportunity?"

"Don't worry! I'll be gentle!"

The color visibly drained from Xu Qianqian's face. No girl was unafraid of pain.

"Just leave it there. I'll do it myself."

"A sprain needs to be treated immediately. You're not strong enough, and you'll be left with a bruise." Jiang Nian pulled over a small stool and raised an eyebrow. "Hand over your stinky foot."

"You're the one with stinky feet! Smell it if you don't believe me!" Xu Qianqian reluctantly extended her small, snow-white foot.

Perhaps because girls are so fond of washing their feet, there was no dead skin on the sole. Instead, it was rosy with a hint of pink, and her toes curled up like snow-white glutinous rice balls.

Because of the way she was extending her leg on the sofa, the hem of her pajamas tightened, outlining the full, round curves of her chest, making it look exceptionally alluring.

Jiang Nian only glanced at it before looking away, wondering to himself when they had gotten so big.

He poured some liniment into his palm and focused on pressing it against the swollen edge of Xu Qianqian's ankle. He applied some force, then began to rub in circles.

(End of this chapter)
